children.text: Japan's Temporary Visitor visa is intended for purposes such as short-term business visits, visiting relatives/friends, or tourism.
The visa is valid for three months, and the planned trip must take place within this validity period. The consulate generally issues 15-day visas.
Booking a Japan tourist visa interview with the consulate is done by phone. On the scheduled day, you must appear in person at the consulate and submit the required documents.

page.title: How to apply for a Japan tourist visa?

children.text:
🔹 A detailed list of documents tailored to your travel purpose.
🔹 A simplified application form.
🔹 Review of the submitted information by professionals.
🔹 Phone and online support.

To apply, the following steps must be completed:

🔹 Completing the visa application.
🔹 Booking a consulate appointment.
🔹 Gathering the required documents.
🔹 Visiting the consulate.
🔹 Receiving the visa decision.
After submitting your application, you may need to wait 7-10 calendar days. Keep in mind that your trip must fall within the visa's 90-day validity period.
The Japan tourist visa is issued based on the number of days requested.

page.title: How long is the Japan tourist visa valid?

children.text: Two visa application forms
A photo, size 35x45
Passport (valid for at least 6 more months)
Financial documentation
Copy of ID card
Itinerary in Japan
Accommodation documents
Flight reservation documents
Documents must be valid at the time of application and submitted no later than three months from their date of issue.
Any documents submitted at the time of application will not be returned to the applicant, except for the passport.
The visa application review period is approximately one week, though this may vary depending on the specifics of the application.
The applicant may be asked to submit additional documents. If necessary, documents may be forwarded to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Tokyo for further review.
Be honest and accurate in your application and avoid providing false information.
The visa's validity period is three months. This validity cannot be extended.
Submit your visa application so that your travel dates fall within the visa's validity period. Visas cannot be requested in advance of a specific future date.
The Japanese consulate does not charge a visa fee.

content.text: What determines whether I'll get a visa?

children.text: It's difficult to predict the likelihood of a specific applicant being granted a visa. However, it's clear that this depends on your social and economic ties in your home country. The more you can show the consul that you are successful in your home country, have a stable income, and future growth potential, the more likely you are to be granted a visa.
The Japanese Embassy, which handles visa matters for Georgian citizens, is located in Tbilisi at 64B Chavchavadze Ave, Hilton Business Center building, 9th floor.

content.text: Can the decision on a Japan visa be guaranteed or challenged?

children.text: No one else can interfere with the consul's decision on issuing a visa; this decision is final. However, our qualified professionals will do everything possible to prepare your documents properly and in your favor for the consulate, so the consul fully understands your current circumstances and prospects, which increases the likelihood of the visa being granted.

content.text: How long does it take to receive the visa?

children.text: In most cases, documents are reviewed within 7 days of submission. However, the review period may be extended or shortened depending on specific circumstances.
